page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "denfum" read as densum, "veftigia" as vestigia, "conftructam" as constructam). "Michaël" kept with its diaeresis as printed. "Sed esto" reads "efto" in print, taken as esto. Some faint stains and show-through at the left and right edges were ignored.
